name: HR³ MATRIX SCALP BRUSH

description:
The HR³ MATRIX Scalp Brush is a specialized scalp care tool designed for daily massage and treatment preparation. It is a gentle, non-invasive brush engineered primarily for scalp care, stimulation, and supporting overall hair health.

The Scalp Brush promotes better circulation, exfoliation, and enhanced product absorption on the scalp. Its ergonomic design features soft, flexible silicone bristles optimized for scalp use without causing irritation.

This professional-grade brush integrates seamlessly with the HR³ MATRIX hair care line, creating the perfect combination for comprehensive scalp treatment and hair loss prevention.

✨ PERFECT COMBINATION: Use together with HR³ MATRIX HAIR TONIC α for maximum results. The brush stimulates blood circulation and opens follicles, allowing the KFDA-approved Hair Tonic to penetrate deeper and work more effectively.

howToUse:
PERFECT ROUTINE WITH HR³ MATRIX HAIR TONIC α:

1. Scalp Preparation (Dry Massage): Use the Scalp Brush on dry scalp for 2-3 minutes. Massage in circular motions to stimulate blood flow. Focus on areas of concern (thinning, tension, buildup).
2. Apply Hair Tonic: Apply HR³ MATRIX HAIR TONIC α to targeted areas. The pre-stimulated scalp absorbs the tonic more effectively. Let tonic sit for optimal penetration.
3. Final Massage: Gently massage the tonic into scalp with fingertips. Do not rinse - leave for continued treatment.
4. Apply HR³ MATRIX MEDI SCALP SHAMPOO α to wet hair
5. Use the Scalp Brush to massage in circular motions
6. Focus on areas with buildup or excess sebum
7. Massage for 2-3 minutes to deeply cleanse
8. Rinse thoroughly

ALTERNATIVE USES:

Wet Use (with shampoo):

Daily Relaxation Massage:
Use on dry scalp anytime for stress relief
3-5 minutes of gentle circular motions
Helps relieve tension and promotes relaxation
directions:
💫 PERFECT COMBINATION GUIDE

For best results, use the Scalp Brush with HR³ MATRIX HAIR TONIC α:

The HR³ MATRIX HAIR TONIC α is KFDA-approved for improving hair loss symptoms. When combined with regular scalp brush massage, you can enhance the tonic's effectiveness through:

1. Improved Blood Circulation - The brush stimulates blood flow, bringing more nutrients to hair follicles
2. Better Product Absorption - Massage opens follicles for deeper tonic penetration
3. Scalp Detoxification - Regular brushing removes buildup that can block hair growth
4. Consistent Treatment - Daily routine ensures optimal results

RECOMMENDED ROUTINE:
• Morning: Dry brush massage (2 min) → Apply Hair Tonic
• Evening: Wet brush with shampoo (optional)
• Weekly: Combine with HR³ MATRIX SCALP PEELING for deep cleanse

CARE INSTRUCTIONS:
• Clean brush after each use with warm water and mild soap
• Allow to air dry completely
• Replace if bristles become worn or damaged
• Store in a clean, dry place

PRECAUTIONS:
• Avoid use on irritated, wounded, or infected scalp areas
• Not recommended immediately after scalp procedures
• If irritation occurs, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist
• For external use only
